study.question: Can tasks read complementary, target-conditioned historical feedback evidence without reopening the harmful shared item-embedding path? Local limitation: g3-r0007-label_fields_shared improves auxiliary AUC relative to private fields but reduces click AUC from 0.6601638278 to 0.6592436764; other-fields and all-fields sharing reduce it further to 0.6588321915 and 0.6583354011. The private parent retains auxiliary AUCs 0.84849008/0.86590234/0.86866553, whereas click incumbent g3-r0005-fixed_aux_items reaches 0.6604035937 with much weaker 0.61036708/0.68534327/0.55698500 auxiliary AUCs. These are single-seed observations, not established task conflicts. Exact match/channel sufficiency has not been diagnosed; its absence in the inspected forward is the observed representational gap, not evidence of efficacy.
study.hypothesis: A small input-derived representation of target category/brand equality crossed with historical feedback channels can supply useful complementary evidence to each task without sharing item-table gradients. Existing learned pooling must infer exact matches from embeddings and task rows; deterministic counts may preserve support and association that pooling obscures. Each task independently learns a linear readout across all channels. This tests representation/readout sufficiency, not beneficial transfer of auxiliary labels. Conditional prediction: preserving both target equality and feedback identity should improve click compared with their respective information-removal controls while retaining learned-private auxiliary performance.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary mechanism text, lines 256-277, uses target-dependent unnormalized local activation to retain interest intensity. This study inherits the local adapted pooling and adds explicit channel-by-semantic-match counts/fractions with task-specific additive logit readouts; it does not replace DIN or claim invented interest intensity.

Pinned git 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, forward lines 123-159, averages projected event embeddings with host multi_masks to initialize feedback hubs and performs repeated token/hub updates. We concretely reuse the idea of feedback-resolved aggregation using those same authorized masks; we aggregate deterministic target matches instead of learned hubs and use a one-stage task readout without broadcast or attention. No local INFNet result is asserted.

study.proposed_difference: Add a 40-dimensional input-only evidence tensor: channels [all exposures, then the four feedback masks in label order], bins [all valid history, known same category, known same brand, known same category AND brand], statistics [log(1+count)/log(1+history width), count/max(channel support,1)]. IDs zero and any declared padding IDs are excluded from field matches. The same category and brand are a same-event conjunction; no future-time or cross-event joining is attempted. All features are FP32-accumulated under disabled autocast, finite and zero for empty histories. Add one zero-initialized bias-free 40-to-4 dense matrix after the inherited reset, then add its logits before sigmoid. No extra RNG draw or embedding gradient route is introduced. M=0 replaces equality by known-field availability (retaining target missingness); F=0 averages the four feedback feature blocks after nonlinear transforms and broadcasts that mean, leaving exposure blocks fixed. All four standalone modules share the implementation and differ only in those two config/default booleans.
predictions: Preflight, before any full run: check finite [B,1] four-task predictions and backward gradients in train/eval, inherited parameters and Dice buffers against unaugmented private model at the same seed, and exactly zero correction/equal parent outputs at initialization. Confirm 160 new dense parameters and no extra sparse tables or reset calls.

Host information checks: arbitrary in-vocabulary perturbations to padded history IDs/actions and feedback masks while keeping the history mask zero there must not change predictions or gradients; changing target action must not change outputs. Empty and zero-width histories must yield finite zero evidence. Known missing/padding category/brand must not generate false equality. Missing IDs use the available declared sentinel only; unprovided OOV semantics remain a limitation.

Host algebra checks: overlapping feedback masks count independently; a simultaneous permutation of history fields/actions/masks leaves only this new evidence branch invariant. F=0 evidence is invariant to permutation of the four feedback-channel identities, while F=1 generally changes if identities differ. This does not assert permutation invariance of every inherited layer. Altering target category/brand equality must change M=1 evidence on a constructed match but not M=0 except through retained missingness.

Main prospective contrast: AUC11>AUC10 and AUC11>AUC01, ideally accompanied by auxiliary AUC/logloss retention, with AUC11 approaching or exceeding the private parent 0.6601638278 and separately compared to click incumbent 0.6604035937. Differences <=0.0003 are flagged as small, seed-sensitive follow-up candidates, not confirmatory evidence or significance thresholds.

Inspect all four task AUC/Logloss and inherited history slices with sample/positive/negative counts. Exploratory new slices, if host diagnostics are authorized, are predeclared by support: zero versus at least one category/brand match, zero versus nonzero historical auxiliary feedback, and empty history; no outcome-tuned bins. Without those diagnostics do not assert slice-specific mechanisms.

Uncertainty plan after a consequential gain: target three paired host seeds for selected candidate and closest factorial controls when budget/host phase permits; request paired user-cluster bootstrap only through an authorized scorer that exposes it. Report unavailable intervals as unavailable. Seed repetitions are robustness checks, not independent mechanism contrasts.
falsifiers: Any leak of current labels/target action, dependence on padded IDs, incorrect mask order, nonfinite output/loss, altered inherited initialization or failure to place the evidence matrix in the host dense optimizer blocks scientific interpretation until corrected; failed costs remain charged.

AUC11 not exceeding AUC10 weakens the feedback-identity claim for this readout; AUC11 not exceeding AUC01 weakens the target-match claim. If all four cells improve similarly, the evidence supports generic history statistics rather than the claimed resolved matching interaction.

A click improvement paired with large auxiliary losses of quality does not validate the proposed complementarity. A single small gain over an archive cannot establish beneficial auxiliary supervision, causal task transfer, novelty or general transfer to production.

No gain under this fixed one-pass linear-readout recipe is a negative implementation result. It does not establish absence of useful target-conditioned evidence: redundant embeddings, weak optimization, insufficient rare-feedback support or a nonlinear readout bottleneck remain alternatives.
alternative_explanations: Trajectory audit: r0000 feedback-in-score with joint gradients was below its item-only control, whereas r0001 click-owned selector improved feedback and item variants. r0002 live auxiliary selector lost to wide-primary control; r0003 item-gradient isolation improved click but damaged auxiliary AUC. r0004 partial item-gradient restoration and uniform auxiliary loss reduction did not beat full isolation. These results motivate separating representation access from task interference, not assuming feedback is uniformly beneficial.

r0005 learned-private tables recovered auxiliary quality with little click change; frozen-private tables produced the highest measured click AUC but poor auxiliary quality. r0006 hidden residuals were unsuccessful across learned/fixed donors and auxiliary/self controls. r0007 exact private replay matched r0005, while both sharing axes hurt click. No archived trial in the visible trajectory index has a failed execution status; poor predictive trajectories are scientific negatives, not missing-data or runtime failures.

Explicit matches may only expose repeat-ad/category popularity and support more cheaply than the inherited network, rather than improve multi-task collaboration. Coarse offline labels and possibly immature delayed actions limit production relevance. Counts cannot verify a causal mechanism.

Feature collapse changes rank and conditioning despite identical parameter allocation. AdamW dynamics, clipping and shared-context auxiliary gradients can produce differences. This factorial distinguishes information availability within a fixed implementation, not all capacity or optimizer explanations.

cost_plan.stop_rule: No training or installation in this coding environment. Do not silently shrink inputs, alter precision/optimizers, add epochs, raise limits, or duplicate unknown-state runs. Stop this suite if preflight integrity fails, resources cannot fit while keeping the reserve, or no admissible informative run remains. Null or failed experiments are not scientific success.
